description: Return OHLCV bar history for a symbol at 1m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, or 1d (default). Intraday intervals require Pro. History depth is set automatically by your API key's plan — do NOT pass a tier argument (there is none): Free sees the last 30 days; Physical sees the last year; Pro unlocks full history back to 1996 (XAU/USD). Dates must be ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Returns bars in date-descending order. volume is null for spot instruments (XAU/USD, XAG/USD, XCU/USD); real for futures (GC, SI, HG) and ETFs (GLD).
name: get_historical
title: Get Historical Prices
